faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to your questions here

salesIncrease.question: Will my sales really increase in the first month?
salesIncrease.answer: Yes! Our average agencies see a 120-150% reservation increase in the first month. Because now you're serving your customers at midnight, on weekends, anytime. You don't miss any opportunity.

setup.question: Can I do the setup myself?
setup.answer: Absolutely! Setup takes 5-10 minutes and is very simple. Add your WhatsApp Business number, upload your tours - that's it. We manage all the technical infrastructure. Our support team will help you if you get stuck.

whatsappCost.question: Is there an extra fee for WhatsApp integration?
whatsappCost.answer: No! We manage the WhatsApp Business API infrastructure. All you need to do is add your own WhatsApp Business number to the system. API usage fees are on us, you only pay your chosen plan fee.

payment.question: Can I collect payments directly from customers?
payment.answer: Yes! With SiPay integration, you can send instant payment links via WhatsApp and collect payments in 2 minutes. Payment tracking and invoicing are automatic.

tourLimit.question: How many tours can I add?
tourLimit.answer: You can add unlimited tours in all plans. The difference is only in the monthly WhatsApp message limit. You can upgrade your plan anytime based on your needs.

cancellation.question: What happens if I cancel?
cancellation.answer: You can cancel anytime, no contract. When you cancel, you'll continue to receive service until the end of the current period. We don't even ask for a credit card during the 14-day free trial.
